axis_note: Preset packs and levels are SEPARATE axes. Levels = how much lighting/effects (L0-L5). Packs = a saved lighting style/stack set onto a scene. Pack version numbers are never level numbers. Naming is exactly 'lighting pack version five' / 'lighting pack version six', NOT 'lighting pack level five/six'.

example_gold_v4_l3.mix_cause: AgX view transform tone mapping (default in Blender 5.2.3) desaturating warm gold; Glare alone measured negligible on the V4 core rim

example_gold_v5_l3.mix_cause: semi-transparent split ring (max alpha 0.627) over cyan/teal environment mixing in AlphaOver, plus gold+cyan bloom overlap at the seam, plus AgX

color_tracking_rule.rule: NEVER call a color the wrong color once things have been overlaid/changed. Record input_color AND on_screen_color AND mix_cause when they differ.

version_five.call_it: pull up lighting pack version five
version_five.name: lighting pack version five
version_five.rim: flat rings, cyan inner / gold outer (V4) or split gold-left / cyan-right (V5)
version_five.source: V4/V5 BEFORE stack (pre-L3, L2-looking, proof before panels)

version_six.call_it: pull up lighting pack version six

godray.read: bright teal volumetric wash, soft shaft separation

version_six.level_equivalent: L3 stack (but pack version != level; do not call it level six)
version_six.name: lighting pack version six
version_six.rim: layered dual rim, cyan inner (0-2px) / gold outer (2-5px) (V4) or split inner+outer (V5)
version_six.source: V4/V5 AFTER stack (L3 stack, proof after panels)
version_six.view_transform: AgX (Blender 5.2.3 default — see color-shift study: this shifts gold, see LEVEL-4-5-SPEC section 5)
